verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time, export all your channels, and choose Markdown (an open format) or Any-Block, and they state "You can leave anytime. Your data goes with you." Community complaints about opaque on-disk storage concern the native storage format, not the export feature, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: evidence that Markdown export preserves databases, relations and files without loss; any open format beyond Markdown for structured data (e.g. CSV/JSON); independent hands-on confirmation of a complete export and migration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Choose your preferred format: Markdown or Any-Block.
You can import content into your spaces and export it at any time.
export all your channels, and import them into a new identity after switching the network mode
You can leave anytime. Your data goes with you, and Anytype can't stop you.
